name: anchor_bead
doc: The pr evaluator holds the PR of the bead an open bead names, until that work is filed with a blocks edge. The merge anchor a review, rework, finding or validation child names (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.gates]). A listing names it on each bead, and prstatus's in-flight set reads it. The bead whose PR a bead's work finishes. Intake admits such PR-finishing work to a pool. A placement refuses PR-finishing work, which follows its anchor and is never a member of an epic.

name: blocked_reason
doc: Why a bead on the record is blocked: the merge it awaits, or the exception that holds it.

name: branch
doc: The source branch a work bead's change is on, which the work formula's workspace-setup writes, and the PR's branch on each ask gctk review ask files. A bead carrying it is in flight. The pr evaluator and the landing order hold a PR whose head branch is not this one, a PR's composition finds the beads whose work the branch carries by it, and a review run takes only an ask that names the branch of its PR.

name: check_name
doc: The check a review lane of the old review path runs. The unmarked list passes over a bead that carries one, as work in flight.

name: check_set
doc: The review checks a bead's change is gated by, as a comma list (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.gates]). A composition names it when no pre-open gate resolves from it.

name: eng_bead
doc: The engineering bead a feedback pattern's structural remedy was filed as ([metadata.learning]), one of the pattern's follow-ups whose landing ends a memory note's wait on the pattern.

name: epic_boundaries
doc: What an epic's work is not (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_closure_condition
doc: An epic's closure checks (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_handle
doc: An epic's 3-5 word handle (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_hypothesis
doc: An epic's one-sentence hypothesis (docs/epics.md). An epic under an epic that carries none is a Delivery.

name: epic_indicators
doc: An epic's leading indicators (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_ruling
doc: The latest ruling on an epic's hypothesis: continue, shift or close (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_ruling_at
doc: When the operator made the latest ruling on an epic.

name: epic_ruling_reason
doc: Why the latest ruling on an epic was made, written with it.

name: epic_shifted_at
doc: When the operator last ruled shift on an epic, written with that ruling and left standing by a later one, so a shift a later ruling followed still reads (skills/converse-epic-review/SKILL.md). An epic that carries none records no shift beyond its ruling keys.

name: epic_weighed_at
doc: The time of the read the rig's po last weighed an epic from at a portfolio sync, the time gctk epic unweighed prints first, written with the sync's note on the epic (skills/portfolio-sync/SKILL.md). An epic that carries none has not been weighed.

name: existing_pr
doc: The PR the refinery reuses rather than open another, a PR's URL: armed with the marker before the record's second write, and set by a requeue. A publication clears it.

name: failure_key
doc: The failure a tracker tracks, which assets/scripts/preexisting-failure.sh stamps in the create that files the tracker. Intake admits a tracker to a pool, because a failure on a base branch is work to fix.

name: finding.scope
doc: Which patrol filed a patrol finding, which patrol-finding.sh writes in the create that files it. It is a mark the first reaction's sweep reads: a finding that carries one and no headline takes a reaction, so a finding whose first sling failed gets one on the next sweep.

name: fold_target
doc: The branch a bead's work was folded onto by a polecat (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.merge_identity]). A bead carrying it has its work on that branch.

name: gc.acceptance
doc: On the human gate under the key first-reaction, the dispatch input of the acceptance that answers it: a JSON object {token, formula, vars}, with vars the <key>=<value> strings its sling carries. gctk reaction accept writes it before the answer that names the token, and a run that finishes that acceptance slings the vars recorded under the token, so a finishing run given no var dispatches what the operator accepted. A record whose token no answer on the gate names binds nothing, and the next acceptance overwrites it. Never cleared.

name: gc.attempt
doc: The iteration a review run's step runs in, from 1, which Gas City writes on every step of a check loop's iteration, a lane bonded there included. A step's output names the same iteration.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready
doc: The pool or agent an armed bead is slung to once nothing holds it. Its presence is the arm. gctk bead arm writes it with the rest of the arm, and gctk bead disarm and the start clear them together.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_args
doc: The formula the arm pours, as the JSON array of sling arguments that names it: ["--on","<formula>"] or ["--on=<formula>"], or [] or absent for the target's default formula, read at each start. Any other value is a record the start reports as malformed and slings nothing on.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_armed_at
doc: When the bead was armed, in RFC 3339 UTC, which gctk bead arm writes to the nanosecond. The title of every root the start pours for the arm carries it, in the token arm:<bead>@<armed at>. The bead's dispatch lock writes its arms one after the other, and the nanosecond keeps each arm's token apart from the token of any arm written before it.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_armed_by
doc: Who armed the bead.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_fail_count
doc: The sling attempts the start has made on the arm, as a decimal integer, raised in one write before each sling. At the cap, GC_MAX_DISPATCH_SLING_FAILURES (3 by default), the start asks a person instead of slinging. Absent means none.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_reason
doc: Why the bead was armed, as free text.

name: gc.execution_routed_to
doc: The route Gas City's sling stamps on a work bead whose workflow it started, which stays while the bead is unassigned and its workflow's steps are claimed. An ask carries none, so a bead that names a PR's branch and carries one is work of its own on the branch.

name: gc.final_disposition
doc: How the runtime finally closed a control bead. A review run's loop that reads hard_fail was ended by a step's hard failure, so the run records no result.

name: gc.formula_contract
doc: The formula contract a root was poured under. A root reading graph.v2 is a run's root.

name: gc.formula_name
doc: A live workflow root of mol-feedback-distiller in the home rig's store is a distiller run that is still going, and gctk distiller start slings no other while one is. The run link reports a run's formula as its root's. The formula a workflow root was poured from, which Gas City stamps at the pour (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.runtime_owned]). A live root of mol-pr-review that a blocks edge of a PR's bead names is a review run attached to the bead, and the landing order marks no PR ready while one is.

name: gc.handback
doc: On a conversation, the latest hand-back its converse sitting posted, whole, which gc-helm.sh handback writes, each record replacing the one before (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.human_surface]).

name: gc.handback_at
doc: When a conversation's latest hand-back was recorded, RFC 3339 UTC, written with it.

name: gc.input_convoy_id
doc: The input convoy a graph.v2 workflow root was poured over. The convoy tracks the bead the run works, and the bead a live run works is in flight once the run has passed load-context. A root without it works the bead its gc.var.issue names.

name: gc.kind
doc: The runtime's kind of a bead. A root reading workflow is a run's root. A review run's loop is the bead of its run that reads ralph, the control bead of its checked step. The unmarked list passes over a bead whose kind is workflow, scope or spec, a topology root.

name: gc.outcome
doc: The terminal disposition a step records. A review run's loop that closed reading pass passed its check.

name: gc.output_json
doc: A step's structured output, one JSON object, which the step writes before it closes. A review run's triage, lanes and rule-and-repair each write theirs in the shape the review domain declares.

name: gc.pr_close_disposition_kind
doc: The kind of close a ruling recorded for a bead whose PR will not land: re-homed, folded, fixed-upstream, duplicate or not-needed, the kinds bead-rehome.sh closes a bead under.

name: gc.pr_close_disposition_successor
doc: The bead a recorded disposition closes its bead onto: the bead that carries the work now, or under not-needed the evidence that ruled the work out, such as the conversation of the sitting that ruled.

name: gc.pr_close_disposition_successor_store
doc: The store of a recorded disposition's successor, rig:<name>, when its id prefix alone does not place it.

name: gc.recommended_formula
doc: The execution formula a first reaction's recommend exit puts to the operator beside the exit's human gate: gctk reaction accept, which a sitting's sign-off runs with --accept, slings that formula at the bead. gctk reaction dispose sets it once the gate is filed and clears it before any exit acts, so no recommendation is older than the newest first-reaction gate. gctk reaction accept clears it in the write that records its dispatch. converse-invalidate-recommendation.sh clears it and converse-signoff.sh reads it, in shell (docs/gctk-architecture.md, Debt). Absent or empty, the bead carries no recommendation.

name: gc.recommended_formula_dispatched
doc: The formula gctk reaction accept slung at the bead for its recommendation, written in the update that clears gc.recommended_formula, so absent means no Accept has recorded a dispatch. An Accept that finds it and no recommendation says the recommendation was dispatched, and so does a sitting's sign-off, which converse-signoff.sh reads in shell. Never cleared. A formula name.

name: gc.root_bead_id
doc: The workflow root a step was poured under. A review run's outputs are on the beads that name its root. The unmarked list passes over a bead that names a root, which is a step.

name: gc.routed_to
doc: gctk bead arm refuses a routed bead, which is dispatched already. An ask carries none, so no pool claims it and the review run is the one that works it. The pool, agent or person a bead is routed to (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, ROUTE and [metadata.runtime_owned]). A bead on a branch that a pool still holds has not pushed its work. The pool or agent a bead is routed to, written by lifecycle.sh's --route and by the script or formula that owns the bead's dispatch (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, ROUTE and [metadata.runtime_owned]). A first reaction takes no bead routed anywhere, which has a dispatch path. A placement clears the route of a held bead, which gctk bead arm refuses, before it dispatches it.

name: gc.session_id
doc: The session that claimed a bead, written by Gas City's claim and left by its release (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.runtime_owned]). The session domain reads it as the session a bead names its owner by, and the seat-progress look as the seat a claim belongs to.

name: gc.step_id
doc: The id of the formula step a step bead carries out, which Gas City writes at the pour. The unmarked list passes over a step.

name: gc.step_ref
doc: The formula step a step bead carries out, as <formula>.<step>. A live run with an open step whose ref ends in .load-context has not passed load-context. A review run's step's place in its formula. Its last part names the step, triage, rule-and-repair or lane, which says the output the step writes. The unmarked list passes over a bead that names the step it carries out.

name: gc.takeaway
doc: A bead's headline: the one line, at most lifecycle.TakeawayMax codepoints, that its handling concluded, which gctk bead takeaway writes and every exit of a first reaction and every sitting's sign-off leaves. The first reaction's sweep passes over a bead that carries one, as one already triaged, and its check refuses a held bead that carries one. Absent, nothing has concluded on the bead.

name: gc.takeaway_at
doc: When the bead's headline was written, RFC 3339 UTC to the second, in the update that writes it.

name: gc.takeaway_by
doc: Who wrote the bead's headline, such as host, proactive or converse, in the update that writes it. The first reaction's sweep passes over a bead that carries one, as one already triaged, and its check refuses a held bead that carries one.

name: gc.takeaway_settled
doc: 1 when the writer of the bead's headline said nothing waits on the bead, and empty when it named a wait or said neither, written with every headline so no earlier headline's answer stands for a later one. lifecycle/lifecycle.toml [holds] pairs it with gc.takeaway, so a headline left with neither an edge nor this mark reads as a hold on prose.

name: gc.var.branch
doc: A review run's branch var: the PR's branch, read when the bead that owns the PR names none.

name: gc.var.head
doc: A review run's head var: the head the refinery validated, the run's first head. A review run's head var, which Gas City stamps on its root at the pour: the head the landing order poured it at. The order counts a closed run at the PR's validated head toward its re-offer.

name: gc.var.issue
doc: The bead a classic molecule's issue variable names, which a root that names no input convoy works. A root whose input convoy tracks another bead works none.

name: gc.var.max_attempts
doc: A review run's max_attempts var: the loop's bound, which Gas City compiles the loop's check from, so the iteration that reaches it is the loop's last and its check records the run's result when it does not pass.

name: gc.var.pr_bead
doc: A review run's pr_bead var: the bead that owns the PR the run judges.

name: gc.var.target
doc: A review run's target var: the branch the PR merges into, the target its result is for. A review run's target var, which Gas City stamps on its root at the pour: the target its result is for. The order counts a closed run for the record's target toward its re-offer.

name: gc.work_outcome
doc: A work bead's self-reported disposition (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.runtime_owned]). A bead reading no-op put no work on its branch. A work bead's self-reported disposition, no-op or shipped, whose meaning is the runtime's (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.runtime_owned]).

name: last_woke_at
doc: When a session last woke, RFC 3339 in UTC, which Gas City writes on its session bead at each wake and clears when it stops (internal/session/lifecycle_transition.go at gastownhall/gascity c7eb6d2f43). The seat-progress look counts a seat's silence from no earlier than it, so a seat restarted in place is judged only on the time it has run.

name: merge_hold
doc: A hold on the bead's merge, set by hand. Any value but an unset spelling holds the PR.

name: merge_result
doc: Where the work a bead carries stands on its way to its target. On Gas Town's pending record it reads pull_request_pending, pull_request_head_changed, mr_merged, pull_request_record_incomplete or one of the exceptions, pull_request_reconcile_invalid, pull_request_closed_unmerged, pull_request_merged_unvalidated_head, pull_request_merge_evidence_contradiction, pull_request_legacy_closed_unverified and pull_request_merged_close_refused, each of which keeps the bead blocked behind a human gate keyed by its value. Absent, the bead has not landed and owns no open PR. Outside the record it reads merged for a direct landing, and blocked or refused_false_completion for the refinery's park. A PR's composition reads a bead on its branch that carries one as the branch's anchor, and one that reads merged, or mr_merged, pull_request_merged_close_refused or pull_request_merged_unvalidated_head, as having landed its work on its merged_target.

name: merged_sha
doc: The merge commit the landing order found on the target when it closed the bead.

name: merged_target
doc: The branch the bead's PR is to merge into, the base its PR must name, and once it lands the branch it landed on. A PR's composition reads it to find the beads that landed on the PR's branch.

name: molecule_failed
doc: Gas City's stamp on each bead of a pour that failed part way (markFailed in internal/molecule). The start reads it on a root its token titles or gc sling's exit 3 names, and Accept on a root its token titles: one that carries true is an attempt that failed, and any other is the pour that landed.

name: observed_pr_head_sha
doc: The head the landing order found on a PR open at a head the refinery has not validated. The next publication clears it.

name: pool_managed
doc: true on the bead of a session Gas City runs as a pool seat, which its work ladder paces (ladderGoverns in cmd/gc/work_ladder_lane.go at gastownhall/gascity c7eb6d2f43). The seat-progress look judges only such a seat.

name: pr_comment_answered
doc: The inline comment id through which the review threads have answered the comments past the comment watermark. A value that is not a whole number reads as 0.

name: pr_comment_watermark
doc: The highest inline comment id the intake has routed. A value that is not a whole number reads as 0.

name: pr_github_read
doc: GitHub's side of a PR as the one-PR update (gctk pr refresh) last read and saved it, one JSON object on the bead that owns the PR, in four parts, each with read_at, the instant its read was sent, and, but for labels, signs, the cheap signs read no later than its facts. pr: the PR's id, its node id on GitHub, its url, number, repository, head_branch and base, its head, state, draft, merge_state, in_merge_queue and merge_queue_enabled, and merge_commit and merged_at once it merged, with the signs state, draft, head, base, base_tip and updated_at. checks: head and runs, the required check runs at that head as {name, status, conclusion}, with the signs head, rollup, contexts, check_runs and statuses, the last two counts by state. conversation: since, the provenance instant the definition of feedback was applied from; approvers and requesters, the accounts that can push whose approval or request for changes stands; feedback, the newest feedback id in each id space as {review, inline, conversation}; awaiting, the review threads waiting on the city's answer; unresolved, the unresolved threads; review_decision; and approvals, each review that approves and has not been dismissed, whoever gave it, as {id, author, commit, inline}, inline the newest inline comment it carries that is feedback, with the signs comments, reviews, dismissed, updated_at, newest_post, the latest time a post changed, and viewer_reactions, each reaction the account the read runs as left on an inline comment, as the comment's id and the reaction, which the definition of feedback reads as an answer to the comment's thread, absent when there is none. labels: names, every label, which are their own signs. The update writes a part only when its read was sent after the saved part's: the whole part when it differs, and its read_at alone when it holds the same, so a read sent before it is never saved after it. A read that fails saves nothing. It holds no answer. The pr evaluator decides over it for a display, the PR's status: and held: labels among them, as current only while it holds the pr, checks and conversation parts, the checks at the PR's head, names the record's repository and number, its head is the head the store holds (observed_pr_head_sha on a changed head, pr_head_sha otherwise) and its since is the bead's pr_provenance_since. Absent or not current, GitHub's side of the PR reads as unread. The landing order finds and does its work from it and the store, and reads GitHub first only for a merge: it has the update read every part of the PR again, and decides the merge on what that read saved. The order's label comparison reads the labels it saved, and labels that differ from the derived ones make a label write due, on an open PR or, for one it shows merged or closed, a clear.

name: pr_head_sha
doc: The head the refinery validated, the one head the bead's PR may merge at. A requeue keeps it.

name: pr_issue_comment_watermark
doc: The highest conversation comment id the intake has routed. A value that is not a whole number reads as 0.

name: pr_last_checked_at
doc: When the one-PR update last read GitHub's side of the PR and saved it on a bead on the record, RFC 3339 UTC to the second. A pass of the PR watch that finds the PR unmoved writes nothing, so it says when the PR was last read and saved, not when GitHub was last asked about it.

name: pr_merged_at
doc: When GitHub says the PR merged, recorded with the merge commit.

name: pr_number
doc: The number of the PR the record names, in decimal.

name: pr_provenance_since
doc: The instant from which a post under the city's login is feedback unless it carries the city's mark. A value that is not an instant in GitHub's form makes every such post the city's own.

name: pr_reconcile_pending
doc: true while a reconciliation of the record is still owed, the marker the landing order selects the records it reads by. The record's first write sets it, and the order clears it when the bead closes on a verified merge, has its changed head handed to the refinery, meets an exception or has been released from the refinery. A disposition's close clears it in the same write, through bead-rehome.sh, the one shell writer that spells it, because only that write closes the bead under the record lock.

name: pr_repo
doc: The repository of the PR the record names, owner/name, which matches the rig's origin and is compared without case.

name: pr_review_answered
doc: The review id through which the review threads have answered the reviews past the review watermark. A value that is not a whole number reads as 0.

name: pr_review_watermark
doc: The highest review id the intake has routed. A value that is not a whole number reads as 0.

name: pr_state
doc: The PR's state as the one-PR update (gctk pr refresh) last read and saved it, lower-cased: open, closed or merged. The update writes it, with pr_last_checked_at, in each write it makes to a bead on the record, and nothing else writes it.

name: pr_summary
doc: The account of what a change does, for its PR, in freeform markdown. `gctk pr summary` is its one writer: the polecat records it on the anchor at submit, and an integration effort's summary task on the effort's landing bead once the effort's work has landed. The PR's managed summary region carries it (`gctk pr compose`), and `gctk pr summary` prints it for a reader of the PR's text. Absent or blank, the dispatch text stands in. Never cleared: the next record replaces it.

name: pr_url
doc: The URL of the PR the record names, https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<number>.

name: proposal_bead
doc: The prompt-update the distiller filed for a feedback pattern ([metadata.learning]), one of the pattern's follow-ups whose landing ends a memory note's wait on the pattern.

name: rebase_hold
doc: A hold on bringing the bead's branch current, set by hand. Any value but an unset spelling holds the PR.

name: rejection_reason
doc: Why the work was sent back to the refinery: a head it has not validated, or a record left half written. A publication clears it.

name: review_checks
doc: On an ask, the checks it sends back, a comma list of names from the check index at the PR's validated head, which gctk review ask writes as it files the ask. A review run picks each at the first head it judges once it can take the ask. Absent, the ask sends back no check.

name: review_results
doc: The review loop's results on the bead that owns a PR, a JSON array of {head, target, passed, run}, one for each head and target a run judged, run naming the root of the run that recorded it, which the loop's check writes through gctk review passed --record under the store's record lock, replacing the entry for the same head and target. The pr evaluator counts only a result for the PR's live head and target, and reads none while the key is absent. The landing order counts a closed run as one that recorded its result only while the entry for its last head names it.

name: rig_check.lint
doc: The published copy of a recorded check's result, which `gctk rig <check> --publish-bead <bead>` writes on the bead its caller names: the record the call answered with, as one JSON object of check, result, scope (absent on a lint or typecheck run), commit, tree, exit_code, duration_ms, runner, recorded_at and command. gctk writes it only once the record store holds the result it copies, after recording a result or answering from a record. No pack path reads it: the record under the rig clone's git common directory answers a later call. Absent means no call published that check to the bead. Never cleared: the next publish replaces it. Its commit is the one the check ran at: the head the call answered for, or, for a full-suite test pass answered through the tree, an earlier commit with the same tree.

name: rig_check.test
doc: The published copy of a recorded check's result, which `gctk rig <check> --publish-bead <bead>` writes on the bead its caller names: the record the call answered with, as one JSON object of check, result, scope (absent on a lint or typecheck run), commit, tree, exit_code, duration_ms, runner, recorded_at and command. gctk writes it only once the record store holds the result it copies, after recording a result or answering from a record. No pack path reads it: the record under the rig clone's git common directory answers a later call. Absent means no call published that check to the bead. Never cleared: the next publish replaces it. Its commit is the one the check ran at: the head the call answered for, or, for a full-suite test pass answered through the tree, an earlier commit with the same tree.

name: rig_check.typecheck
doc: The published copy of a recorded check's result, which `gctk rig <check> --publish-bead <bead>` writes on the bead its caller names: the record the call answered with, as one JSON object of check, result, scope (absent on a lint or typecheck run), commit, tree, exit_code, duration_ms, runner, recorded_at and command. gctk writes it only once the record store holds the result it copies, after recording a result or answering from a record. No pack path reads it: the record under the rig clone's git common directory answers a later call. Absent means no call published that check to the bead. Never cleared: the next publish replaces it. Its commit is the one the check ran at: the head the call answered for, or, for a full-suite test pass answered through the tree, an earlier commit with the same tree.

name: task_kind
doc: A memory note that waits on a bead whose task_kind is feedback-pattern waits on the pattern's follow-ups. A bead's role (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml). An ask carries none, so a bead that names a PR's branch and carries one, such as a rework child, is work of its own on the branch. A standing kind and a feedback pattern take no first reaction, and the unmarked list passes over them and over a review lane.

name: withdraw_head
doc: The head a withdrawal of a PR's approvals names, on the bead `gctk pr withdraw` files, which blocks the bead that owns the PR. The landing order dismisses each approval that stands on a commit that does not contain this head, and closes the withdrawal once none stands. Written once, when the withdrawal is filed, and never cleared.

name: work_dir
doc: The worktree a bead's work is built in, which work-setup.sh writes. The unmarked list passes over a bead that carries one, as work in flight.
